set.def: a change in the genes of a living thing or virus, which may be harmful, helpful or harmless

why: 'genetic code' technically means the codon-to-amino-acid table, not an organism's DNA sequence; examples and cloze are about viruses, which the old def ('living thing') did not cover

set.def: any number, positive, negative or zero, that can be written as a fraction of two whole numbers, with the bottom not zero

why: In US school math 'whole numbers' are 0,1,2,..., so the old def left out negative fractions such as -1/2, which are rational

set.note: In math, golden mean is also another name for the golden ratio, about 1.618; that is a different idea.
ex: Following the golden mean, Aristotle said generosity lies between being stingy and wasting money.
Priya applies the golden mean to work, putting in steady effort without slacking off or burning herself out.

why: Old note said the golden mean is 'not the same as the golden ratio', but 'golden mean' is a standard name for the golden ratio in math; ex2 'effort that is ... burned-out' was ungrammatical

ex: Tobacco smoke is a known carcinogen, linked to lung cancer and many other cancers.
Workers removing old insulation wear masks because asbestos is a powerful carcinogen.

why: ex1 'many chemicals that are known to be a carcinogen' was ungrammatical (plural/singular mismatch)

ex: Yogurt with live cultures is one of the most common sources of probiotics.
Hannah's doctor suggested a probiotic to help her stomach recover after a course of antibiotics.

cloze.s: The yogurt label said each cup is packed with ___, live bacteria that help keep the gut healthy.

why: 'sources of a probiotic' and 'contains a probiotic with billions of bacteria' were unnatural usage

ex: Her heart pounded as adrenaline surged through her body when the car swerved toward her.
Tomás carries an adrenaline injector pen in case he has a severe allergic reaction to peanuts.

why: 'a pen of adrenaline' is unnatural; endorphin removed because 'a rush of endorphins' is a common collocation that could tempt in the cloze
beta-endorphin is released into the blood by the pituitary and affects mood, so the hormone def could be argued as a correct answer to (a)
RAM also holds copies of recently used data for fast access (browser memory cache lives in RAM); could answer (b) or the cloze
a CPU cache is also short-term working memory wiped at power-off, so the cache def/term overlaps RAM's
'watershed' also means a ridge dividing drainage areas; 'Rivers west of the watershed in the Rockies drain toward the Pacific' fits the cloze
general election is the counterpart stage, not an opposite; a forced antonym for test (f)

set.why: It is closely tied to the Romani people of Andalusia and is on UNESCO's list of the world's intangible cultural heritage.

why: 'grew largely from the Romani people' overstates a contested origin (Andalusian, Moorish, Jewish and Romani influences); UNESCO listing (2010) is intangible heritage

set.why: Companies, unions and advocacy groups all do it; in the US it is legal, and paid lobbyists must usually report their work publicly.

why: Not all lobbying must be publicly reported; federal disclosure applies to paid lobbyists above set thresholds

ex: The hedge fund made a fortune by betting that the company's stock would fall.
Most ordinary savers cannot join a hedge fund, since these funds are open only to wealthy investors and require large minimums.

why: ex2 had a number mismatch ('a hedge fund ... they require') and omitted the main barrier, investor-eligibility rules
